/.title: Oil Find：文件、应用、剪贴板，一处搜索
/.description: 按 ⌘Space 打开 macOS 搜索面板。搜索文件与应用，选择性保存剪贴板文本、链接和本地文件路径引用，离线计算和单位换算；网页搜索只在你提交时打开。免费版采用 MIT 许可证并始终免费；Pro 是独立的闭源付费扩展。

/en.title: Oil Find: files, apps and clipboard in one search panel
/en.description: Press ⌘Space to open a native macOS search panel. Find files and apps, opt in to clipboard history for text, links and local file path references, calculate offline and open web searches only when you submit. The free version is MIT licensed and stays free; Pro is a separate closed-source paid add-on.

/pro.title: Oil Find Pro：搜图片和文档里的文字，拔掉的硬盘也能搜
/pro.description: 截图、照片里的文字与画面，PDF、Word 等文档里的文字都能搜，全部在本机处理；外置硬盘拔掉后也能搜到。¥49 一次买断，可以免费试用 7 天。

/en/pro.title: Oil Find Pro: search inside images and documents on Mac
/en/pro.description: Search the text in screenshots, photos, PDFs and Office documents, all on your Mac, and keep unplugged drives searchable. $9.99 once, 7-day trial.

zh.q: 和 Spotlight 有什么不同
zh.a: Spotlight 同时搜索文件内容、应用和网页。Oil Find 使用自己的文件名索引，支持拼音首字母、通配符、正则和实时更新。
和 Windows 上的 Everything 思路一样：给磁盘上的文件名建一份索引，输入即出结果。Everything 只有 Windows 版，Oil Find 是为 Mac 写的原生应用。

en.a: Spotlight searches file contents, apps and the web. Oil Find uses its own file-name index, with pinyin initials, wildcards, regular expressions and live updates.
It works like Everything on Windows: an index of every file name on your disk, with results as you type. Everything is Windows-only; Oil Find is a native Mac app.

privacy.zh: 文件引擎只读取名称、大小和修改时间。剪贴板记录默认关闭，启用后保存文本、链接和本地文件/文件夹路径引用，在本机加密并由钥匙串保护；文件只保存路径，不备份或读取正文。敏感、临时、自动生成标记和来源应用排除继续生效，图片内容和尚未生成的文件承诺不采集。汇率来源只接收固定的公开币种列表，不发送金额或完整查询。网页搜索只在你选择并提交后打开；fork 构建不连接上游官方应用更新服务。
privacy.en: The file engine reads names, sizes and modification dates only. Clipboard history is off by default; when enabled, it saves text, links and path references to local files and folders, encrypted locally and protected with Keychain. File references store paths without backing up files or reading contents. Concealed, transient and autogenerated markers and source app exclusions still apply; image content and ungenerated file promises are not captured. Currency requests contain only a fixed list of public currency pairs, never the amount or full query. Web search opens only after you choose and submit; fork builds do not connect to the upstream official app-update service.
